name: 保存した住所のショートカット
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0007 保存した住所のショートカット: three horizontal saved-place shortcuts.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: input1 ORIGINAL controls icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical weight, spacing/alignment and fine details. Relevant source region x35 y769 width1108 height185: Home / Work / More. Input2 rough mock is secondary Japanese copy and layout ONLY; correct its wrong plus-sign More glyph. Input3 approved bus direction is style only.
Preserve original icon anatomy: first clean outlined house with pitched roof and doorway; second outlined briefcase with short centered handle; third THREE HORIZONTAL DOTS, not a plus, menu lines or new feature. Each icon inside a small equal circular backplate, then its two-line text to its right. Arrange three groups in one horizontal row, original equal optical alignment, compact spacing, no big buttons.
Exact copy: first "自宅" with "住所を登録"; second "職場" with "未設定"; third "その他" with "一覧を見る". No invented address, values or heading.
Accent decision: original's three blue glyphs coherently identify the saved-location shortcut group. Retain ONE blue #2176D9 for ALL3glyphs, subordinate to Lighthouse primary branding, no random category hues. Keep circle surfaces white with fine neutral outlines, not the mock's mint fills. Labels ink #1D1D1D and secondary #6E6E6E.
Pure-white #FFFFFF outer canvas and component, subtle rounded white shared surface, fine neutral edge and faint shadow, no nested heavy borders. Japanese Meiryo Regular14/24 labels and12/16 metadata, zero tracking, delicate regular weight, one line each. Uniformly scale logical390px-wide row. Flat frontal high-resolution wide3:1 with modest white margins. Exclude source search/current-location/history/contacts/device chrome/logos. Preserve all six labels and three original icons, no extra controls.
reviewNotes: 原参照を優先して自宅・職場・その他の図形を確認。モックの誤ったプラスを原の横3点へ修正。住所ショートカットという一貫した補助グループの青を保持しミント円は白い円へ。6つの日本語、未設定状態、横並び、欠けなしを視認。静止画像のエージェントレビューのみ、フォントの厳密一致・所有者承認・編集可能性・実装は未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
